feeding_claim.verbatim: Rockin' B Ranch cattle graze in our pastures, are fed hay grown on our land and are finished on a corn-based feed.

notes: Unpublished 2026-11-08: site says calves are born in Mt. Ida, Arkansas and brought to the Pearcy ranch after weaning; check whether those calves come from the family's own cows or are bought from another producer. Free delivery within 30 miles of the ranch; farther by arrangement. No quarters sold. $500 deposit. Summer 2026 beef sold out; taking orders for January 2027.
